definitions.explanation: A {屏風|びょうぶ} (folding screen) covered in silver leaf. Conceptually paired with the {金屏風|きんびょうぶ} (gold screen) but quieter in impression, used for more subdued or refined settings.

examples.japanese: {銀屏風|ぎんびょうぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧。
examples.english: to set up a silver folding screen

examples.japanese: ⟦{茶室|ちゃしつ}→茶室：14081_chashitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{銀屏風|ぎんびょうぶ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{飾|かざ}られていた→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧。
examples.english: A silver folding screen was displayed in the tea room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{金屏風|きんびょうぶ}→金屏風：29403_kinbyoubu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{銀屏風|ぎんびょうぶ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦{印象|いんしょう}→印象：01846_inshou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧だいぶ⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
examples.english: A gold screen and a silver screen give quite different impressions.

notes:
The silver-leaf counterpart of the ⟦{金屏風|きんびょうぶ}→金屏風：29403_kinbyoubu⟧; calmer and more understated in feeling.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{屏風|びょうぶ}→屏風：06228_byoubu⟧: folding screen
- ⟦{金屏風|きんびょうぶ}→金屏風：29403_kinbyoubu⟧: gold folding screen — brighter, more celebratory
